$comment: S44 district crime statistics (T088). Measure columns added to the common envelope (common.json). Field map: configs/sources/s44.yaml; rules: decision D114.

fields.name: district_id
fields.meaning: police unit as published (DISTRICT/UNITS or Districts); not a revenue district

fields.name: unit_kind
fields.meaning: district, commissionerate, range_subtotal, state_total or no_area (railways, coastal security, CID)

fields.name: offence_category
fields.meaning: column header as published (offence head, or IPC Cases / SLL Cases / Total)

fields.name: population_year
fields.meaning: always null: no population is published with the tables

valid_at: end of the calendar year, IST
not_included: names, case locations and individual cases: none are published or stored
